Quantitative analysis of tumor-derived methylated p16INK4a sequences in plasma, serum, and blood cells of hepatocellular carcinoma patients. PURPOSE AND EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN Using real-time quantitative methylation-specific PCR (RTQ-MSP), we quantified methylated p16INK4a sequences and determined the fractional concentrations of circulating tumor DNA in plasma, serum, and peripheral blood cells collected preoperatively, intraoperatively, and postoperatively from 49 patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). RESULTS RTQ-MSP was sufficiently sensitive to detect down to 10 genome-equivalents of methylated p16INK4a sequences.
